# robinhood-chain-launcher

> Autonomous coin launcher for Robinhood Chain: concept → 3D logo → deploy on NOXA or Uniswap v3 → announce. CLI, HTTP API, and an autonomous agent.

robinhood-chain-launcher is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
